title: NAF 28227(9)
contents: Bossuet correspondence concerning ecclesiastical controversy, censures and ordinances, assemblies, printed works, diplomacy in Rome, and church appointments.
status: 3/32 pages transcribed; 28 more in part; 12/28 cipher pages deciphered; 16 more in part
fields: Includes letters to the abbé Bossuet
Original cipher key in the same volume, PDF 345-346.
Historical interlinear plaintext survives on the selected letter pages.

excerpt: Je ne vois que faire pour ce qui est icy **une querele particuliere.**
translation: I do not see what to do about what is a private quarrel here.
